title: Fix puzzle image tiles not rendering in 3x3 sliding puzzle

requirements.text: Fix the 3x3 sliding tile puzzle in PuzzleMinigame.tsx so that couple-ayce.jpg renders correctly as individual tiles. Each tile must use CSS background-image with background-position calculated per tile index to slice the correct portion of the image, ensuring the full photo is visible across the assembled grid. The image path must correctly reference /assets/generated/couple-ayce.jpg.
acceptanceCriteria: Each tile in the 3x3 grid displays the correct cropped region of couple-ayce.jpg using CSS background-image and background-position/background-size.
When all tiles are in solved order, the full couple-ayce.jpg photo is visible as a seamless image across the grid.
The empty tile (blank space) has no background image rendered.
The image loads without broken image indicators or blank white tiles.
The puzzle remains functional — tiles can be slid, move counter increments, and completion detection still works.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
The image asset path must remain at /assets/generated/couple-ayce.jpg (served from frontend/public/assets/generated/couple-ayce.jpg).
Do not change the puzzle logic in useSlidingPuzzle.ts — only fix the rendering in PuzzleMinigame.tsx.
nonGoals: Replacing or modifying the couple-ayce.jpg image.
Adding new features to the puzzle page (music, animations beyond what exists).
Modifying the Valentine Message page or Home page.
